now.title: Iron Man
now.text: Raza brings the wrecked armor to Obadiah Stane, who paralyzes him and has him killed.

proposed.text: Raza brings the wrecked armor to Obadiah Stane, who paralyzes him with a sonic taser and has his men killed.

changes.evidence: In Iron Man, Stane paralyzes Raza with a sonic taser and has Raza's soldiers killed; Raza himself survives (fandom status Alive) and returns in VisionQuest episode 6, leading Ten Rings soldiers in Madripoor until Paladin subdues him. So 'has him killed' is wrong and the status should not be Deceased (F3 too).

now.title: Iron Man 2
now.text: Christine covers the Stark Expo, where Justin Hammer shows off his drones.

proposed.text: In Monaco, Christine interviews Justin Hammer for Vanity Fair, then leaves him to chase the story when Tony enters the Grand Prix.

changes.evidence: Christine's Iron Man 2 scenes are in Monaco: she interviews Hammer for Vanity Fair and abandons him when Tony takes over his race car. Every character summary gives no Stark Expo appearance for her; the reporter covering the Stark Expo is Chess Roberts.

now.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
now.text: Happy watches over Peter Parker for Tony, but he is busy moving the Avengers' gear out of Stark Tower and misses the boy's warnings.

proposed.text: Happy watches over Peter Parker for Tony, but he is busy moving the Avengers' gear out of Avengers Tower and misses the boy's warnings.

changes.evidence: By Spider-Man: Homecoming the building is Avengers Tower (renamed from Stark Tower after the Avengers made it their headquarters); Happy oversees clearing out Avengers Tower after Tony sells it. The Dum-E file already calls it Avengers Tower for the same event.
